Shop Operations Guide (test fixture)

1. Storage instructions
Milk, curd and paneer must be stored below 5 degrees Celsius. Open packs of curd should be sold within 2 days.
Bread and bakery items should be kept in a dry shelf away from sunlight and sold within their printed shelf life.
Rice, dal and flour must be stored in sealed containers off the floor to avoid moisture and insects.

2. Return policy
Packaged items can be returned within 7 days with the bill if the seal is unbroken.
Perishable items such as milk, curd, paneer and vegetables cannot be returned after 24 hours of purchase.
Damaged products are replaced by the supplier if reported within 48 hours of delivery.

3. Supplier payment terms
Payment to all suppliers is due within 15 days of the invoice date. Early payment within 5 days earns a 2 percent discount.
Orders below the supplier's minimum order value are charged a flat delivery fee of 50 rupees.

4. Reducing wastage
Follow first-expiry-first-out: place the batches that expire earliest at the front of the shelf.
Mark down items by 20 percent when they are within 2 days of expiry to sell them before they spoil.
